parsed.rationale: All five members are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural signal is purely that they are zero-field type aliases — not that they alias the same underlying type or encode the same domain concept. `Discogs.Release.Label`, `Discogs.Release.ReleaseArtist`, and `Discogs.Master.ReleaseArtist` in `Artwork/DiscogsArtworkService.swift` are Discogs API response shape aliases, while `Release` in `Metadata/_Plant_ReleaseRepository.swift` and `Artist` in `Metadata/_Plant_ArtistRepository.swift` are repository-layer convenience aliases for entirely different domain types. The coincidence is structural (all happen to be empty-body type aliases) rather than semantic, and the `_Plant_` prefix on the Metadata files further suggests these are scaffolding/generated stubs that should not be merged with the Artwork service types.
